niche.habitat: Ring edges, shear zones, and L4/L5 interface swarms
niche.diet: Ice, organics, gametes of grazers, silicate fractures
niche.active: Active during high-velocity shear; rests in L4 shadows

body: Asymmetric teardrop, spring-loaded spore capsules, reflective dorsal scale

links: High flux at 0.575 AU raises thermal load
Radiation pressure also exerts thermal stress

skill.effect: Reflects radiation burst; deals 10 heat damage to nearby enemies, costs 10% health

chains.weakness: Overheat risk; flash reduces own insulation temporarily

journal.en: Survival is a matter of reflecting the fire.

links: Capsules launch gametes with mechanical force
Gametes must be aimed by orbital phasing

skill.effect: Launches spores to ally orbit; heals 15 mass and adjusts ally inclination by 0.1°

chains.weakness: Aiming error; miss can waste spores or hit enemies

journal.en: Love is a calculated orbit in the dark.

analogues.mechanism: see the cited works; chain wording is the council's own

links: Jaws fracture silicate and ice matrix
Silicates provide structural material for shell
Cracking releases trapped organics and ice

skill.effect: Fractures target; deals 8 damage and releases 5 ice mass to attacker

chains.weakness: Slow processing; unable to crack large silicate chunks quickly

journal.en: The rock is the skeleton of the sky.

links: Star is K2V dwarf with 4950 K photosphere

skill.effect: Detects peroxide frost and heat signatures; reveals hidden grazers

chains.weakness: Blind to IR; thermal cloaking is effective

journal.en: In the amber light, the invisible becomes visible.

relations.note: (council kind 'Competitor') Cintillo targets Polvovela spores and grazes in the same shear zones
(council kind 'Competitor') Cintillo targets Polvovela spores and grazes in the same shear zones

body_plan.origin: Descended from L4 ice-bodies; teardrop stabilizes in granular vacuum

secrets: Cintillo can ride Coth's cryovolcanic plume debris to enter orbit.
Spore shells can phase-shift orbit slightly to avoid collision.
Iridophores can be tuned to hide thermal signature in ring shadows.
moments: A Cintillo drifts through a Kessler cascade, its reflective scales turning the debris field into a blinding kaleidoscope, guiding the swarm through the storm by reading the light of colliding ice.

journal.en: Life here is a balance of burn and bite.
The L4 swarm is a graveyard of ice; the Cintillo is the ghost that wakes it.
